newsitem.title: USA: Stocks end higher with rally in technology shares.
newsitem.headline: Stocks end higher with rally in technology shares.

text.p: The stock market closed modestly higher Wednesday on the back of a swift recovery in battered technology stocks, but bank shares were dragged lower one day after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in more than two years.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 4.53 points at 6,880.70, while the technology-laced Nasdaq Composite index jumped 21.00 points to 1,269.06.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on active volume of 490 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
